notes.title: Aliens Attack VR is out now and FREE!
notes.content:
[b]Aliens Attack VR is available![/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34819582/e388922b8d036429fad9881cad792a99f6d374a8.gif[/img]

Shoot, hit and smash those cute annoying aliens with combination of your two weapons and use power ups to blast them into space. Defend your space station and get the [b]Highscore[/b].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34819582/3ef0476af397c9f75bd28ea89f715e47df4b0c1b.jpg[/img]

Oh, and it has 17 challenging achievements ready to unlock.
Tell your friends and defy them to beat your score and get into the [b]top ten list[/b]. And rememeber: it's completelly [b]FREE[/b]!
Have fun :D

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34819582/eb933036f0d579e41a69175d29a5ef32f383d9a2.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Aliens Attack VR is ready!
notes.content:
More than 3000 people played Aliens Attack VR at events during 2018, now it's time to enjoy it, completely FREE, on Steam.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34819582/eb933036f0d579e41a69175d29a5ef32f383d9a2.jpg[/img]

Challenge your friends and get the best score. You only have 2 minutes to defend the energy pillars from those annoying aliens.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34819582/6368586e69d02b4478b115911b46bc4382274040.jpg[/img]

Unlock achievements and have FUN!
